verdict.rationale: Claude Design has no standalone CLI of its own. Its product page does document official terminal access through Claude Code, Anthropic's CLI: the /design slash command for working on designs and /design-sync for pulling in a design system, plus handoff bundles passed to Claude Code. This is a single thin mention of command-line use through a sibling tool, which is why the confidence is low. missing for 10: a dedicated Claude Design CLI, documented commands and flags beyond /design and /design-sync, scripting/automation docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of /design in the terminal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Pull in your design system from Claude Code using /design-sync or work directly in Claude Code with /design.
Claude packages everything into a handoff bundle that you can pass to Claude Code with a single instruction.
